name: Modern Apartment In Nizami
description:
About this propertySpacious Accommodation: Modern Apartment In Nizami offers a spacious apartment in Baku. The property features three bedrooms and three bathrooms, ensuring ample space for guests.

Essential Facilities: Guests enjoy free WiFi, air-conditioning, and a terrace with sea views. Additional amenities include a balcony, streaming services, washing machine, and a fully equipped kitchen.

Prime Location: Located on Nizami Street, the apartment is a few steps from Fountains Square and an 8-minute walk to Maiden Tower. Nearby attractions include the Azerbaijan Carpet Museum and Palace of The Shirvanshahs. Heydar Aliyev International Airport is 24 km away.

Local Attractions: Explore nearby sites such as Flame Towers, Baku Railway Station, and Upland Park. An ice-skating rink is also available in the surroundings.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

policies.title: Cancellation/ prepayment
policies.content: Cancellation and prepayment policies vary according to accommodation type. Please check what conditions may apply to each option when making your selection.

policies.title: Children and beds
policies.content: Child policies Children of any age are welcome. Children 18 years and above will be charged as adults at this property. To see correct prices and occupancy information, please add the number of children in your group and their ages to your search. Cot and extra bed policies 0 - 3 years Cot upon request The number of cots allowed is dependent on the option you choose. Please check your selected option for more information. There are no extra beds available at this property. All cots are subject to availability.

policies.title: No age restriction
policies.content: There is no age requirement for check-in

policies.title: Pets
policies.content: Pets are allowed on request. Charges may be applicable.
